setup.gt_primary: z_near = forward depth of nearest 3D-box corner
setup.camera: per-image P2 focal/principal point; camera height 1.65 m
f = 700 px @ 1280x720 (BDD maintainer), principal point = image centre, H_c = 1.3 m (assumed)
setup.boxes: BDD100K box_track_20 GT (5 fps); video frame from per-clip pixel-matched anchors (MOT_ANCHORS, review fix)
setup.vehicle_filter: car/truck/bus, not occluded, not truncated, h >= 15 px, not touching border
setup.ground_reference: geometry-only estimator: flat ground with horizon from virtual horizon + principal-row prior (no depth model)

runtime_provisional.note: RTX 5060 Laptop 8 GB shared with up to 6 other agents (GPU 26-73 % busy during runs); batch 1; includes resize + upsample to 1280x720; re-benchmark alone

metric3d_vit_s_onnx.note: ORT arena, not visible to torch stats

da3_metric_large.verdict: depth = raw * f_net / 300 with f_net = focal at the network input resolution (DA3 code path) is correct; original focal over-estimates ~2.3x

da2_metric_outdoor_small.verdict: no intrinsics input; learned the VKITTI camera; ~2x over-estimate on BDD (f_net 504 px vs ~1000 px at training) -> use calibration='scale_from_height'
